officialSources.observation: Official Tamil Nadu Government Land Management System landing page. It describes integration of RoR, cadastral maps/FMB, and land-information systems, and names the Commissionerate of Land Administration and Department of Survey and Settlement as stakeholders. The visible portal sign-in requires email/mobile, password, and captcha; no login was attempted.
Official Tamil Nadu land-record e-services endpoint identified by government-service discovery as the Integrated Land Record service. Direct anonymous fetch timed out during this attempt.

Official TamilNilam citizen service identified by first-party/app documentation as a location-based map service for Tamil Nadu land records, FMB sketches, and survey/subdivision navigation. Direct anonymous fetch timed out during this attempt.

Official Vadalur Municipality page labelled Vadalur Final Municipal Town Map; this is municipal map context, not evidence of parcel-level cadastral geometry. Direct fetch timed out during this attempt.

Official TNGIS application directory. It states that TNGIS data are informational and that ownership remains with respective departments; no Vadalur parcel layer was verified in the anonymous request.
